notes.title: SOULBOUND Patch 0.8.3
notes.content:
Patch notes:

- Updated method to activate time rewind
- Updated UI to show remaining rewind time
- New local rewind time tutorial
- Updated tremor intensity -thanks apspnp
- Player Raycast fix
- Changed direction on ropes (and there is a new option on settings to change that) -thanks apspnp
- Jump gravity updated
- Added a window in which you can still grab the rope after pressing the button

tags.feature: - Updated method to activate time rewind

- Changed direction on ropes (and there is a new option on settings to change that) -thanks apspnp
- Added a window in which you can still grab the rope after pressing the button
